T: Steal the moon. Eat the bananas.
D: A supervillain adopts three orphan girls as part of a plan, and gets more than he bargained for.
P: Serve dessert when the girls take Gru to the theme park.
S: the little yellow helpers who love bananas
Banana coins dipped in yoghurt and frozen, half rolled in crushed peanuts and half in yellow sprinkles.
the girls selling boxes of cookies door to door

Chewy coconut cookies with golden edges, half dipped in dark chocolate and packed into little boxes just like the girls sell. Heat the oven to 170C. Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar until creamy, then beat in 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 150g plain flour, half a teaspoon of bicarb and 120g desiccated coconut. Roll into 20 balls, flatten slightly on lined trays and bake for 12 minutes until golden at the edges. Cool, then dip half of each in 150g melted dark chocolate and set on paper.
the funfair where Agnes wins the fluffy unicorn
Franks on sticks dipped in a batter of cornmeal, flour, sugar, egg and buttermilk, fried at 180C for 4 minutes. Mustard and tomato sauce.
M: the first dinner in Gru's gloomy house
Beef and pork mince mixed with soaked breadcrumbs, parmesan and parsley, rolled, browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce with garlic and basil, over spaghetti.

Chicken tenderloins in a crunchy parmesan and panko crumb, baked golden, with honey mustard, tomato sauce and a crisp potato wedge pile. Heat the oven to 220C. Cut 1kg potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, paprika and salt, and roast for 35 minutes. Dip 800g chicken tenderloins in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 150g panko mixed with 40g grated parmesan. Lay on an oiled tray, spray with oil and bake for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon with 3 tbsp honey and serve with tomato sauce.
W: Agnes and her fluffy unicorn from the funfair
Vanilla sponges baked at 175C, stacked and covered in fluffy white buttercream, a mane of pastel buttercream piped down one side and a gold fondant horn on top.
K: the moon he shrinks and steals
Full cream milk warmed gently with honey, a cinnamon stick and vanilla, never boiled, poured into mugs at bedtime.

s.note: the little yellow helpers who love bananas
s.how: Slice 3 bananas into thick coins. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a spoon of honey. Dip each coin, roll half in crushed peanuts and half in yellow sprinkles, and freeze on a tray for 2 hours.

s.note: the funfair where Agnes wins the fluffy unicorn
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

m.note: the first dinner in Gru's gloomy house
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 50g soaked breadcrumbs, 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with garlic and basil. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan.

w.note: Agnes and her fluffy unicorn from the funfair
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Cover in 250g butter beaten with 450g icing sugar, pipe a pastel mane down one side and add a gold fondant horn.

d.note: the moon he shrinks and steals
d.how: Warm 1L milk gently with 2 tbsp honey, a cinnamon stick and a little vanilla until steaming, never boiling. Remove the cinnamon and pour into four mugs at bedtime.
